title: Pan-Fried Yautia with Spanish Salsa
description: A delicious and flavorful dish that combines the goodness of yautia with the savory taste of Spanish cuisine.
instructions: Peel and chop the yautia into 1-inch pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped yautia and cook until golden brown, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the tomato sauce and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
For the Spanish salsa, combine the diced onion, diced tomato, and diced red pepper in a bowl.
Stir in the chopped fresh cilantro and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the salsa alongside the pan-fried yautia.
